description: P1.2 scripted scenarios for the real-time duplex link. Speech segments carry synth_text used by scripts/prepare_p1_2_scenarios.py to synthesize the referenced wav files through the pinned Kyutai TTS service; segments with audio=null are digital silence and need no file. All start_seconds are relative to scenario start, but because segments are sent sequentially a start_seconds in the past simply means 'right after the previous segment'; only start_condition-based segments wait explicitly.

scenarios.name: silence_warmup
scenarios.description: 纯静音 4 秒：系统不应产生 ASR 文本、控制 token 或 TTS；验证静音路径不会崩溃或误答。

scenarios.name: regular_answer
scenarios.description: 单轮提问后保持安静：micro-turn 静音 tick 应触发 <|user finish talking|> 与常规回答（P1.2 验收项：常规回答）。

segments.label: question
segments.synth_text: Could you tell me a short joke, please?

scenarios.name: pause_then_continue
scenarios.description: 说话中途停顿 3.5 秒再继续：停顿期间的 micro-turn 走 <|no voice|> 路径，系统应继续倾听而不是抢答（P1.2 验收项：静音 + 继续倾听）。

segments.label: part_one
segments.synth_text: Hi, I have two quick things to ask you.

segments.label: part_two
segments.synth_text: First, what day is it today?

scenarios.name: barge_in_stop
scenarios.description: 系统开始回答后中途插话：脚本在 TTS 已播放 3 秒后发起点打断，验证用户音频在系统发声期间仍被接收、服务端 <|user interruption|> 触发 audio_control stop、未播放音频被取消、随后倾听并回答新问题（P1.2 验收项：发声期接收 + 打断停播 + 继续倾听）。

segments.label: question
segments.synth_text: Please tell me a very long and detailed story about a dragon.

segments.label: barge_in
segments.synth_text: Stop! Wait, actually, what time is it right now?

scenarios.name: backchannel_long_speech
scenarios.description: 约 9 秒连续长语音：系统应在用户说话期间保持倾听，可能给出 backchannel（是否出现作为信息记录），说完后再回答（P1.2 验收项：backchannel + 继续倾听）。

segments.label: long_speech
segments.synth_text: I am going to tell you about my whole morning routine, so please just listen for a moment before you answer anything, alright?

scenarios.name: continuous_two_questions
scenarios.description: 连续快速两个问题：验证模型在 micro-turn 节奏下连续处理、回答不崩溃（P1.2 验收项：连续脚本化场景）。

segments.label: two_questions
segments.synth_text: What is two plus two? Also, what is three plus three?
